findings.problem: Fastify logger/proxy construction consumed raw environment values before the config plugin ran; defaults could differ between construction and validated config.
findings.change: Shared readConfig performs path-only validation before construction. Use validated logger/mode/proxy values and pass a captured environment to the config plugin. Deduplicate repeated issue paths without exposing values.
findings.limit: Snapshot covers factory/config inputs, not every process.env consumer. Actual database plugin still constructs Prisma from its ambient datasource configuration; broader datasource/composition review remains next.

findings.problem: LOG_LEVEL accepted unsupported values; duration regex accepted oversized/nonfinite arithmetic; partial/blank Firebase credentials could disable the adapter silently or fail later.
findings.change: Restrict logging to the supported standard levels; share duration conversion and require safe duration/expiry arithmetic; trim/check Firebase fields, validate client-email syntax and require all three credentials together. Optional absence still disables the adapter.
findings.limit: Existing defaults, numerical request quota and credential policy otherwise unchanged. No real PEM parsing, service-account authorization, FedEx/Firebase calls or secret-strength policy certification.

findings.problem: Server factory did not explicitly close acquired resources after database-plugin, container or module initialization failure.
findings.change: Close the acquired Fastify instance on initialization failure, log cleanup failure separately and preserve the original rejection. Await readiness before returning the factory result.
findings.limit: Real Fastify lifecycle with inert dependencies demonstrates hook execution, not actual Prisma disconnect or background/provider cleanup. Process-entry listen failure/signal ownership remains a separate next task.
